name: dealdesk
description: DealDesk skills and MCP tools for desk cards, email logs, quotes, customers, and portfolio publish.

interface.longDescription: Operate DealDesk from ChatGPT or Codex: create and update desk cards, log email on the card timeline, evaluate configurations, create quotes from the published portfolio, find or create customers, export for analysis, and publish a portfolio only after preview and confirm. Tools run on the agenthouse MCP endpoint. Delete is not available.
defaultPrompt: List open DealDesk cards for my project.
Log this inbound email on the matching desk card.
Create a quote from the published portfolio for this configuration.
